title: Epic: make timer and logging usable
description: Track the MVP functionality needed so a user can start a pumping timer, stop it, log output, see dashboard totals update, and keep data after reload. Scope excludes advanced schedule shifting until the core timer/log loop works.

title: Polish Ringkasan Hari Ini card grid
description: Improve the homepage Ringkasan Hari Ini grid layout and card styling so it looks more refined and readable while preserving existing functionality.

title: Move dashboard sessions into real state
description: Replace hardcoded dashboard totals and session counts with React state and derived selectors. Acceptance: session rows, total output, completed count, average duration, and progress are derived from one session collection instead of constants.
close_reason: Dashboard rows and summary now derive from React session state instead of constants.

title: Persist active timer and logs locally
description: Use localStorage to persist completed sessions and an active timer timestamp/phase. Acceptance: reload during a running timer resumes elapsed time from the stored start timestamp, and saved logs survive reload.
notes: User explicitly said no persistence right now; keep in-memory state until core logging UX works.

title: Save timer result into session log
description: Wire the active timer save flow so Stop & Catat plus Simpan appends or updates a completed pumping session with start time, end time, duration, side, volume, and unit. Acceptance: after saving, the overlay closes and dashboard timeline/totals immediately reflect the new log.
close_reason: Timer save now writes a completed session with start/end, duration, side, volume, and unit into dashboard state.

title: Make manual logging work
description: Wire + Catat Manual to open a logging flow without requiring a running timer. Acceptance: user can enter session time/duration/volume/unit and save it into the same session log used by timer saves.

title: Wire overdue session actions
description: Make overdue Catat and Lewati controls mutate session state. Acceptance: Catat opens logging prefilled for the overdue slot, Lewati marks the slot skipped/clears the alert, and both update timeline state.

title: Generate basic schedule from interval
description: Replace the fixed SESSIONS array with a generated daily schedule from a 3-hour interval and current logs. Acceptance: today schedule shows done/upcoming/overdue from current time and completed logs; interval can remain hardcoded for this slice.

title: Add shift remaining schedule flow
description: Implement the later-session shift prompt after a late completed pump. Acceptance: when a session is logged late, user can choose to shift remaining sessions today and the schedule updates accordingly.

title: Equalize today's summary card heights
description: Ringkasan Hari Ini dashboard cards have inconsistent visual heights because stat cards do not fill stretched grid cells. Make cards equal height in the summary grid.
